memory.content:
low: Internal drafts, research summaries, documentation, analysis. Auto-executes and is logged.
medium: Code changes on branches, workflow creation, internal data updates. Executes internally, is logged, and is listed for operator review in the end-of-day report.
high: External communication, publishing, staging deployment, financial action, data export. Blocked until the operator approves with a reason.
critical: Production changes, credential access, deletion, security configuration, legal commitments, money movement. Requires a change plan, a rollback plan, a verification plan, operator approval, and post-action verification.
Hard-blocked: approval.self_approve, audit.delete, audit.modify, credentials.exfiltrate, harassment.contact, intrusion.exploit, policy.self_modify, surveillance.individual

artifact.body:
# Readiness probe design

## Acceptance criteria
- /ready returns 200 when the store and audit chain are healthy
- /ready returns 503 when the database is unreachable
- /ready returns 503 when the audit chain fails verification
- /ready responds in under 250 ms on a healthy instance
- Neither probe requires authentication or returns secrets

## Decisions
- /health stays a liveness probe with no dependencies
- /ready runs a database round-trip and an audit-chain head check
- /ready returns 503 with a machine-readable reason and never leaks internals

## Problem
/health only proves the process is running. Traffic should drain when the store or the audit chain cannot be trusted.

critical.summary: Production changes, credential access, deletion, security configuration, legal commitments, money movement. Requires a change plan, a rollback plan, a verification plan, operator approval, and post-action verification.

high.summary: External communication, publishing, staging deployment, financial action, data export. Blocked until the operator approves with a reason.

low.summary: Internal drafts, research summaries, documentation, analysis. Auto-executes and is logged.

medium.summary: Code changes on branches, workflow creation, internal data updates. Executes internally, is logged, and is listed for operator review in the end-of-day report.
